'''Sprettyn''' was an [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] serving under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] aboard Zsinj's flagship [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']]. He was caught at least twice playing a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] [[TIE Interceptor simulator module|simulator game]] while on bridge duty. After Sprettyn ignored an order to stop playing games on duty, Zsinj ordered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Melvar]] to take him away and tell the crew of Iron Fist that he had been executed. Melvar was then commanded to secretly put Sprettyn through pilot evaluation. Zsinj indicated Sprettyn was afterwards to be executed for failing to follow orders regardless of his performance.
